description: Create the initial PRD synthesis from repository exploration and project-goal interviews.
Define ProcessError(exitCode: Int, lines: List[String]) as the process error channel.
Change process execution to return Either[ProcessError, A] instead of losing non-zero exits as failed effects.
Return compiler stage output as an attempt with structured success or ProcessError.
Return javap stage output as an attempt with structured success or ProcessError.
Search for generated class files recursively instead of only one directory level.
Expose compiler and disassembler attempts through the compile API response.
Render compiler ProcessError exit code and lines in the left pane when compilation fails.
Render compiler phases as collapsible left-pane sections.
Show compiler and disassembler stage result icons in their respective pane headers.
Show a running indicator label to the left of the Run button and reuse the existing hourglass icon while a request is active
Ensure stale async responses cannot overwrite the newest request result.
Keep async submission tied to the explicit Run action.
Save the most recently successful source form text to local storage and restore it automatically on page initialization.
Add 300ms debounce-on-edit auto-submission while keeping Run as a manual rerun control.
Replace raw stage line payloads with server-side grouped line schemas using separate compiler/decompiler role hierarchies.
Implement server-side compiler grouping into contiguous role runs with roles plain def val var and preserved ordering/empty lines.
Implement server-side disassembly grouping into contiguous role runs with roles plain field method and preserved ordering/empty lines.
Update UI rendering to consume structured group fields only and apply CSS round-robin palettes by role without text parsing.
Extend API and asset tests plus README docs for server-side grouped semantics fallback behavior and declaration-signature highlighting scope.
Define stage-specific hash input models for compiler and disassembler cache keys.
Add Cacheable instances and deterministic slug tests for compiler and disassembler hash inputs.
Thread stage-specific hash inputs through compile request handling without enabling caching yet.
Cache compiler results by compiler-specific hash.
Cache disassembler results by disassembler-specific hash.
Research useful compiler and javap options before adding checkbox controls.
Add compiler option checkboxes only after research identifies useful options, and persist selections immediately via local storage.
Add javap option checkboxes only after research identifies useful options, and persist selections immediately via local storage.
Enable javap line number table output and parse line mappings into structured response data.
Support comparing two Scala snippets and generated outputs side by side.
